candidates.issues: Completely incorrect dish. The photo shows Sabich (eggplant, hard-boiled egg, potato, tahini), while the recipe is for a chicken schnitzel pita.
Missing potatoes in the ingredients and instructions, which are a traditional part of Sabich and clearly visible in the photo as white slices.
Instructs to boil whole potatoes for only 12 minutes alongside the eggs, which is not enough time to cook whole potatoes until soft.
Ingredient proportions are off: 1 medium eggplant and 1 potato are not enough to generously fill 4 pitas along with the 4 eggs.
Very good overall. Slicing the potatoes before boiling ensures they cook in the stated time, and the proportions for 2 pitas are sensible. Missing cucumber for the salad, but perfectly acceptable.
Excellent recipe. Clear, sequential instructions, accurate cooking times (slicing potatoes before boiling is smart), and great proportions for 2 pitas.
